theMappingThisAssignmentAskedFor.ownerAction: Map the exact disposition fact to the correct SCA-C903 ground, refuse unclear records, and release the official-form build.
theMappingThisAssignmentAskedFor.whatTheFormOffersToElect: nothing. SCA-C903 has no AcroForm, no annotations and no selection control of any kind on any of its three pages. Its only enumerated alternatives are the three SERVICE METHODS on page 3 — First Class Mail, Hand Delivery, Certified Mail – Return Receipt — which are methods of service, not grounds for relief. A ground on this form is therefore a printed recital in the body, and the document prints exactly one disposition recital.

refused.measuredOnThePinnedBytes: the word "acquittal" occurs 5 times in SCA-C903 and NOT ONCE in an operative allegation: line 13 is the page-1 title block, lines 53, 71 and 116 are the running footer on pages 1, 2 and 3, and line 87 is the certificate of service naming the document being served. The strings "not guilty", "verdict" and "judgment of acquittal" do not occur in the document at all.
refused.why: the only disposition recital SCA-C903 prints states that the matter WAS DISMISSED BY A COURT, and its blanks are printed "(Date of Dismissal)", "(Type of Court: Municipal, Magistrate, Circuit)" and "(Reason for Dismissal.)". Electing it for an acquittal writes an acquittal fact into blanks the Supreme Court of Appeals printed as dismissal blanks — the same class of defect as a value disclosed by a label one row off its own — and leaves pre-printed paragraph 4 swearing that 60 days have elapsed since "the above referenced dismissal", a dismissal that did not happen, on a motion the movant signs pro se. The nearest ground is not the correct ground and this lane did not select it.

That on ____ (Date of Dismissal), this matter was dismissed by the …" and the same paragraph 4. It was read only to test whether the refusal is an artefact of which binary is bound. It is not, and nothing was substituted.

rows.whyTheFamilyStopsRatherThanShippingHalfO: The refused fact is not a corner of this family. It is the first word of the family id, the first branch of the route's own first required fact, and a separately held eligibility signal in the compiled profile. Delivering a dismissal-only packet under the id wv_nc_acquittal_dismissal-set would ship a family whose name and whose route both promise a disposition the delivered artifact cannot carry. Narrowing a family's scope is an owner decision, not a build step, so nothing was written: the overlay directory data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1/wv/wv-nc-acquittal-dismissal-set--official-pdf-fill was not created.
whatIsNotTheReasonThisStops: CUSTODY. The one declared source resolves byte-exact under the Master Library and its digest was measured twice.

ENCRYPTION. The bound binary is AES-256 (R6/V5) with an empty user password. pdf-lib cannot open it and the committed corpus index records it as structuralClassObserved "unreadable"; poppler and pikepdf open it without a password. It is flat and encrypted, not corrupt, and it could have been decrypted with the empty password and overlaid.
